mapper.select: SELECT pc.id AS plan_case_id, pc.plan_id AS plan_id, pc.case_id AS case_id, c.case_no AS case_no, c.title AS title, c.priority AS priority, c.case_type AS case_type, pc.assignee_name AS assignee_name, (SELECT e.result FROM test_execution e WHERE e.plan_id = pc.plan_id AND e.case_id = pc.case_id AND e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_result, (SELECT e.executed_at FROM test_execution e WHERE e.plan_id = pc.plan_id AND e.case_id = pc.case_id AND e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_executed_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_execution e WHERE e.plan_id = pc.plan_id AND e.case_id = pc.case_id AND e.deleted = 0) AS exec_count FROM plan_case pc INNER JOIN test_case c ON c.id = pc.case_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE pc.plan_id = #{planId} AND pc.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pc.sort_no ASC, pc.id ASC
